summary: Agricycle is a web-based interactive dashboard that helps farmers make smarter crop rotation decisions. It uses NASA satellite data, soil information, climate data, and geographical conditions to generate crop rotation recommendations tailored to individual fields. Through an interactive map and simple dashboard, users can explore locations, enter field details, and receive recommendations based on local conditions and priorities such as soil health and food security. By turning NASA Earth observation data into practical agricultural insights, the platform addresses the challenge while supporting sustainable farming and better resource management.
details:
We developed a web-based interactive dashboard that helps farmers make informed and sustainable crop rotation decisions. Users can select their field location, enter essential field information, and receive tailored crop rotation recommendations.

The platform combines NASA Earth observation datasets, including NASA POWER climate data and MODIS vegetation data, with SoilGrids soil information, elevation data, and crop calendars. Our recommendation engine considers environmental conditions and farmer priorities such as soil health, food security, profitability, irrigation, and risk.

Benefits and Real-World Impact

Farmers can use the platform before planting seasons to explore suitable crops and plan rotations. Agricultural advisors and organisations can also use it to support local farming communities. Our goal is to encourage sustainable agriculture, improve resource management, and contribute to food security.

Importantly, this is a decision-support tool, not a replacement for farmers, agricultural experts, or traditional farming knowledge. It provides additional insights while leaving final decisions in human hands.

Creativity and Innovation

We focus on making complex agricultural technology simple and farmer-friendly through a three-click experience. Instead of requiring users to interpret complicated satellite data, the platform processes it in the background and presents practical recommendations through an intuitive dashboard and interactive map.

Tools and Technologies

  • Frontend: React.js, JavaScript, React Router, Leaflet, React Leaflet.
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy.
  • Data processing: Pandas, NumPy, GeoPandas, Rasterio.
  • Visualisation and utilities: Matplotlib, OpenPyXL, Jupyter Notebook, Python-dotenv.
  • Development tools: Black and Ruff.
  • Additional tools: Csv and Xlsx.

Factors Considered

We considered geographical location, climate, soil properties, terrain, vegetation, crop suitability, planting seasons, irrigation availability, food security, profitability, soil health, water conservation, and agricultural risks. We also prioritized accessibility and ease of use so farmers can benefit without needing technical expertise.
